name: A quest-rewarded belt below its item level keeps no scaling key, so its ArmorDamageModifier split never underflows the unsigned armor (#9342)
contract: Stonefist Girdle (6742, armor 234, ArmorDamageModifier 100) is the second choice of quest 1101 'The Crone of the Kraul' (min level 23). Player::_ApplyItemBonuses subtracted the item's ArmorDamageModifier from the ladder row's reborn armor on a uint32 without saturating; at a low scaling key the reborn armor is below the modifier (100) and the subtraction wrapped to about 4.29e9, applied as a garbage flat armor modifier. Upstream asserts that a level-26 Witch Hunter rewarded the belt stores scaling key 22, below its item level 36, with reborn armor 77. wow-realms: native item scaling only raises an item (ADR-0017), so a key below the item level is never stored and the low-key underflow cannot arise on our realms. The level-26 reward keeps no scaling key (0) and auto-equips the belt, so the snapshot is taken before the reward; equipping it adds the authored copy's ItemAddon.dbc reborn armor (206), which already exceeds the modifier, not a wrapped value. A level-60 character given the authored copy directly (no scaling key; add_item does not auto-equip) is a control with the same delta.
